name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales
description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales is a customer relationship management product for managing accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, sales activities, quotes, orders, invoices, campaigns, and relationship insights on Microsoft Dataverse.
agentUseSummary: Choose the Dataverse environment hosting Dynamics 365 Sales, connect through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth, and let selected agents verify only the bound environment and minimized user, organization, and business-unit IDs. Relay does not expose customer records, sales activity, arbitrary Dataverse tables or actions, or mutations in V1.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's multi-tenant Entra application has not been configured and accepted for the production Dynamics CRM user_impersonation permission and exact Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales callback, and no licensed customer Dataverse environment has completed consent and acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console owner registers or updates Relay's verified multi-tenant Entra application, adds the exact callback, grants delegated Dynamics CRM user_impersonation, stores the client ID and secret in Railway, then validates OAuth, refresh, WhoAmI, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in a licensed non-production customer environment.

evidence.supports: Microsoft describes Dynamics 365 Sales as a Dataverse-based CRM for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, sales collateral, campaigns, and associated service cases.
Microsoft documents the parameter-free Dataverse Web API GET /api/data/v9.2/WhoAmI function and its user, business-unit, and organization identifiers.
Microsoft requires OAuth for Dataverse Web API clients and documents delegated user_impersonation for applications acting as the signed-in user.
Microsoft documents Dataverse service-protection limits, 429 responses, and Retry-After behavior; Relay's single bounded identity request stays far below bulk-use patterns.
